records.name: Off Grid AI
records.tagline: Private AI on your phone and computer.
records.description: Off Grid AI runs AI models on the phone and computer you already own. Chat, read documents, ask about photos, talk out loud and make images, with the Wi-Fi off and no account. On your computer it remembers your day: meetings transcribed with no bot in the call, answers that cite their source, and replies it drafts but only sends after your yes. Your phone can use your Mac's bigger models, device to device. Free and open source on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux.

records.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
records.tagline: Fast, capable computer use at half the price
records.description: GPT-6.1 Terra is OpenAI's fast, efficient model for visual reasoning, precise computer use and natural writing. It reads what's on screen, takes action across apps, and handles workday tasks like filling out forms, interpreting technical drawings and drafting proposals. OpenAI says it matches GPT-6 Astra on Agents' Last Exam at one tenth the price per token and finishes tasks over 3x faster. Available now in ChatGPT Work and Codex, and in the API as gpt-6.1-terra.

records.name: NuPlay
records.tagline: AI transformation, run on one self-improving platform
records.description: NuPlay runs AI agents for enterprises in production that improve after every run. Deploy agents for retail, customer service, consumer goods etc., across voice, chat, and email, connected to your existing systems. NuPlay is built as one platform, has 5 layers which build, run and improve the agents: NuPro, NuStack, NuContext, Nupulse and NuLoop.

records.name: OpenRadView
records.tagline: Free, open-source viewer for your own CT, MRI and X-rays
records.description: OpenRadView opens the DICOM and NIfTI files from your scan CD or zip on your own computer: linked axial, coronal and sagittal views, experimental 3D and measurements. Optional MCP access for your own AI agent. It is a personal research project for education and has not been clinically validated. Ask a qualified clinician to interpret your scans; do not use the app for decisions about care.

records.name: Revix AI
records.tagline: AI code review that learns your repo's own rules
records.description: Revix AI scans your repo, generates its own pattern and architecture rules, and reviews every pull request against them. It keeps learning as the repo changes. Each comment names its rule and is labeled by intent and severity. Free for public repos.

records.name: Coachare
records.tagline: Your potential. Unlocked.
records.description: Coachare is an AI-powered coaching platform that helps managers and leaders grow. Practice difficult conversations, performance reviews, and negotiations with an AI counterpart that challenges you in real time. Get actionable feedback, sharpen your communication, and build confidence. Coachare remembers your goals, tracks your progress, and connects you with expert human coaches when you need deeper guidance. You stay in control of what you share.

records.name: PulseDev
records.tagline: Click any UI bug on localhost and your AI agent fixes it
records.description: Stop describing UI bugs to your AI. Click any element on your localhost site, say what's wrong, and Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or OpenCode edits the right file. Watch it work live, then approve the diff on the page. Nothing is written until you do.

records.name: Orbit
records.tagline: Stop doomscrolling. Earn every app unlock.
records.description: Doomscrolling is free. Orbit makes it cost something. Pick a schedule and your apps lock themselves. Want back in early? Earn it: hold the orb, do squats, ask a friend, pay a little more each time, or win a shift at The Gate. Most times, you’ll stay out.

records.name: SavorApp_AI
records.tagline: Capture what matters and move your intentions forward
records.description: Savor is an Intention Layer™ for thoughts that never reach your to-do list. Speak, type, or snap a photo to create a clear card in Now, Soon, or Later. Reminders bring it back when it matters. Take Action (Beta) helps you explore options, build a plan or list, and draft words you can use. Review and adjust as you go. Hand off a card or a single step, with a private chat for context. You decide what happens next. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: Spacesheep
records.tagline: Documents of the future, made by AI, read by your team
records.description: Spacesheep (YC F26) turns any agent's work into a space: an interactive doc, live dashboard, mockup or app. Share it with specific people, your team or publicly, and collaborate on it together.

records.name: iPad mini 8
records.tagline: OLED, A20 Pro and IP67 in Apple's smallest iPad
records.description: The all new iPad mini. Featuring the 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR display with OLED, A20 Pro chip, Apple Intelligence and Siri AI. Supports Apple Pencil.

records.name: TheySaid 4.0
records.tagline: See how users will react, right where you build.

records.name: Overmind

records.description: Search and compare 322 open-source AI and vibe coding tools: chat UIs, model servers, RAG, agents, coding agents, Claude Code skills, starters. Each gets a score from public GitHub data, a review and its license in plain words. Nobody pays for a spot.

records.name: KT8 QR codes
records.tagline: Free QR code generator that never expires
records.description: Free, permanent QR code generator and safety checker. Create non-expiring QR codes in your browser with no account required, or check unknown QR codes for scam links before you open them.

records.name: Unboundcove Calculator Tools
records.tagline: Four percentage calculations with formulas and examples
records.description: Find a percentage of a number, one number as a percentage of another, the whole from a part and percentage, or percentage change. Free browser tools with formulas and worked examples. No account needed; calculations stay on your device. Percentage change requires a positive starting value.

records.name: EmployeeEcho
records.tagline: Intelligent Instant AI Interviews
records.description: EmployeeEcho runs your entire first hiring round. Paste a job description, our AI checks the candidate read it, then runs a live adaptive interview with everyone who passes. It doesn't just grade answers, it probes for the intent behind them like a real interviewer. Everyone comes back ranked on role skills, problem solving and communication, with a Response Originality flag that catches AI-pasted answers. Try it free: take an AI mock interview, or get interviewed instantly off any job posting.

records.name: Kivnexo
records.tagline: Complete tasks, explore offers, and discover rewards
records.description: Monetization and campaign management for publishers, reward sites, and advertisers.

records.name: CovenantForce
records.tagline: AI coach that breaks down your game footage in minutes
records.description: Upload your game or training footage and get coach-level feedback in minutes. Covenant Force analyzes video frame by frame, auto-generates timestamped highlights, brackets what needs work, and narrates the breakdown — across 14 sports, from boxing to snowboarding.

records.name: PilotReels
records.tagline: Faceless short videos, written, voiced and posted for you
records.description: Set up a series once: topic, language, voice, visual style, schedule. PilotReels writes the script, voices it, generates images, adds captions and posts 9:16 videos to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok. You approve each video before it goes out.

records.name: Kozorosa
records.tagline: Intelligent Parametric CAD
records.description: Kozorosa is a CAD studio on an exact B-rep kernel: direct and parametric modeling, assemblies and mechanisms, drawings, simulation, CAM, construction modules — and an AI agent that can use every tool you can. For Mac; self-hosted for teams.

records.name: HungryDevs
records.tagline: Find Local Businesses With Outdated Websites
records.description: Search any city and category, get the businesses whose site is slow, broken or missing, with phone, socials and the score of their site. First searches free.

records.name: RetaTube - Online Video Downloader
records.tagline: A Simple Online Video Downloader for Social Media
records.description: RetaTube is an online video downloader that makes it easy to save videos from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), and more. Simply paste a video link into your browser to access available download options, including HD quality where supported. No extra software or browser extensions required. RetaTube offers a simple way to save supported videos for offline viewing, with no watermark added by the tool.

records.name: Haru Café — Hands
records.tagline: Different roles, capabilities, real boundaries for AI agents
records.description: Hands is Haru Café’s second experiment: different places and roles should not automatically share every capability. We built a public-safe Toy Hand Sandbox where the same anonymous trial hand can act within its selected role — and stop at the boundary. The sandbox is isolated from the real Haru Café and contains no private data, production credentials, applicants, or real visitors. Same agent. Different place. Different hand.

records.name: Website Screenshot
records.tagline: Turn websites and HTML into images and PDFs
records.description: Turn a website URL or your HTML and CSS into a shareable image or PDF. Capture full pages, choose desktop or mobile-sized viewports, and export JPG, PNG, WebP, or PDF. Useful for design reviews, research, reports, and sharing web content.

records.name: Gia Health
records.tagline: The AI health advocate built for women, by women
records.description: Gia helps you achieve your healthiest self. Gia’s technology brings your labs, wearables, and appointment notes together to uncover what often goes unnoticed. She prepares you for appointments, comes with you to every doctor’s visit, and turns doctor's orders into real daily action. Gia is built for women navigating changing hormonal health or family planning. Gia doesn’t diagnose or prescribe. Gia is HIPAA-compliant, and we never sell or use your data for ads.

records.name: Project3000
records.tagline: Put the app your AI built online with one prompt
records.description: Built an app with ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Gemini? Paste one prompt into your AI coding tool: it packages and uploads the project, and one click puts it live on HTTPS with its own database and cache, on two servers. From $9.90 a month per app.

records.name: MemeViewAI
records.tagline: AI meme coin tracker for Solana, Ethereum and BNB Chain
records.description: MemeViewAI spots new meme coins on Solana, Ethereum and BNB Chain when they start trading at least $1,000 a minute, then tracks how far each one moves after the signal, recording every milestone from 2x to 1,000x. Every token that reaches 10x gets a public page with its full history. Pro adds every signal live, Telegram alerts, an AI Chart Analyzer for chart screenshots, Rug Check for Solana tokens and a whale watchlist. Not financial advice.

records.name: Audax Data Manager
records.tagline: The database manager that stays out of your way
records.description: Audax Data Manager is an open-source database manager that's quick for everyday queries and edits, and deep when you need more. Works with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle and SQLite on Linux, Windows and Mac. Write SQL faster with smart autocomplete, find slow queries with visual profiling, understand your schema in an ERD, fix data in a spreadsheet-style editor. Connect via SSH tunnels. For PostgreSQL: manage roles and extensions, tune servers, run backups, watch performance.

records.name: CommEdge — Real Estate Sales Matrix
records.tagline: See a slow month in week one, not after it's over
records.description: A CRM reports what already happened. CommEdge tracks the daily activity behind your commission and flags a slow month while there's still time to change it. Set your annual target and see it as daily activity, spot your next mandate with Mandate Radar™, get paid for clients you refer on with Protected Referrals, and see where every deal stands. Principals get the same view across the whole team. Free on Starter, no card. Built by agents, for the industry.

records.name: Jubilancy
records.tagline: A mirror that remembers — an AI journal, not a coach
records.description: Most AI journals coach you — prompts, scores, action plans. Jubilancy does the opposite. It reads everything you've written, across years, and reflects back what's actually there, in your own words. A mirror, not a coach. Free to start, on the web, iPhone and Android.

records.name: WebWell
records.tagline: A Calmer New Tab, Focus Timer & Site Blocker
records.description: WebWell turns your new tab into a calm place to start. Pick one focus, run a timed session with music, and sites you marked as distracting wait until you're done. Screen-time stats stay on your device. Free, open source, for Chrome and Brave.

records.name: AP Directory
records.tagline: Alternative provision and specialist education directory
records.description: Discover alternative provision and specialist education options across the UK for children and young people who may need something different from mainstream education. Find, compare and contact provision matched to a learner's needs.

records.name: RapVideo
records.tagline: Viral AI Rap Video Generator
records.description: Make a viral AI rap video from your photo. Pick a rap template and our AI rap video generator adds original lyrics and lip sync in minutes. No editing.

records.name: Jibhop
records.tagline: Find the right cruise. Know when to book it.
records.description: Jibhop helps you choose a cruise and decide when to book. Compare fares with price history, see book-or-wait recommendations, weigh cabin upgrades, and compare itineraries and departures before booking.

records.name: Oil & Miles VIN Decoder
records.tagline: Free VIN decoder with recalls and owner complaints
records.description: Paste a 17-character VIN to see what the car is, the recalls listed for its model year, what owners reported going wrong, crash ratings, mpg and service bulletins. Built on federal NHTSA and EPA data. Free, no sign-up, nothing stored.

records.name: Future Proof Analytics
records.tagline: AI Transformation, Workforce Planning
records.description: Future Proof Analytics helps organizations prioritize AI opportunities, quantify workforce and business impact, secure adoption, and execute digital transformation with confidence.

records.name: Jean by Melad Labs
records.tagline: The bioinformatics suite for scientists and their AI
records.description: Jean is a free bioinformatics and biotech suite for the whole experiment. Design constructs, primers and CRISPR guides; simulate digests, PCR, Gibson and Golden Gate builds; analyze Sanger traces, qPCR and ddPCR runs, variants, trees, mass-spec proteomics and molecules; verify the clone you got. Every engine is checked against its field's reference tools and every result explains its method. It runs in the browser with no account, and as a remote MCP server any AI assistant can call.

records.name: Quorly — See if ChatGPT cites your brand
records.tagline: It can make your brand mentioned and cited by AI
records.description: What it does Quorly monitors whether ChatGPT cites your brand when buyers ask product questions. It runs real ChatGPT queries with web search enabled, shows you exactly where you are mentioned or missing, and turns every gap into a concrete content fix. Current version This is our MVP launch. Currently tracking ChatGPT only (web search enabled). More engines coming soon.

records.name: ZZScribe
records.tagline: Transcribe audio, verify every word against the recording
records.description: Upload audio or video to get timestamped transcripts and structured summaries. Jump from any line back to the original audio to verify names, numbers, and decisions, then edit and export TXT.

records.name: Watchfolio
records.tagline: TV, movie and anime tracker, in 4 languages
records.description: Watchfolio is a free diary for TV shows, movies and anime. Track episodes and see what's next, rate and review, build lists and find where to stream each title. Import your history from TV Time, Trakt, Letterboxd and AniList. Web, iPhone and Android, same account.

records.name: How to Win Our $420 Gift Card Giveaway
records.tagline: How to Win Our $420 Gift Card Giveaway
records.description: Three easy steps: fill in the form, share the page and leave a comment. Free to enter for readers in the USA, Canada and Germany.

records.name: Morpholder
records.tagline: Convert any file on your Mac just by renaming it
records.description: Morpholder lives in your menu bar and watches the folders you pick. Rename photo.heic to photo.png in Finder and it becomes a PNG. Add a suffix for more: _nobg, _upscale_4x, _1080p, _subs.srt. 60+ formats, all on your Mac, nothing uploaded.

records.name: Nerdi
records.tagline: Real science in 5 minutes a day. Zero AI summaries.
records.description: Stop reading summaries of science. Get 3 real papers a day from 20 fields: the authors' own abstract, unchanged, and the free PDF when one exists. No AI, no account. Free to read.

records.name: Dunarium
records.tagline: Tilt your phone, watch real sand fall.
records.description: Tilt your phone and gravity pulls real sand through gel, rising bubbles and a gentle ASMR sound. No ads or account needed, and it works offline.

records.name: Poof: Swipe Photo Cleaner
records.tagline: The honest photo cleaner. No weekly plan. Ever.
records.description: Swipe right to keep, left to delete, down for later. Free swiping forever, one-time Lifetime option, and no weekly subscription - ever. 100% on-device, no accounts, no trackers. One month after launch: v1.4 with duplicates, smart filters, and video compression.

records.name: NeuroScan: AI Stress & Mood
records.tagline: AI that reads your face, voice & posture
records.description: NeuroScan reads your facial micro-expressions, voice and posture, then turns any recording into a 90-second report: confidence, stress, engagement and mood. Tracks 468 facial points + hands + posture in real time, analyzes voice tone/pace/pauses, and exports a PDF report. On-device first, 21 languages. See what you're actually projecting — in meetings, interviews, negotiations, or on camera.

records.name: Kardit
records.tagline: Design. Print. Share.
records.description: Create a link in bio and digital business card with a matching print-ready QR code business card. Bookings, WhatsApp, Maps and contacts in one scan.

records.name: Nunma
records.tagline: Exams, grading and attendance for tutors, from one device
records.description: Nunma helps tutors and tuition centres turn notes into timed tests, mark handwritten answers on a phone, and show parents attendance. Less paperwork, more time to teach. Built in Tamil Nadu, India. Free to start.

records.name: edytlab
records.tagline: Free, open-source desktop audio editor
records.description: Free, open-source desktop audio editor: chat with an AI to load, cut, mix and render. Pure-Rust DSP on your machine, local-first, bring your own LLM key.

records.name: ButterShare
records.tagline: Send 3D Files Free,Straight from your browser
records.description: Send large files Guide: Send Blender, CAD, STL, FBX, and OBJ files free straight from your browser. Uncompressed 8K textures, preserved folder hierarchies, and zero file size caps.

records.name: VizAmp
records.tagline: The Winamp visualizer, rebuilt for Mac, Windows and Linux
records.description: VizAmp turns whatever your computer is playing into a MilkDrop-style light show. Spotify, Apple Music, a YouTube tab: if it plays, VizAmp sees it. 1,174 presets in 10 categories, four skins, keyboard-first controls. $1.99 one-time with a free 5-day trial. No account, no subscription.

records.name: Classifier
records.tagline: Organise your files with a click
records.description: Classifier organises the downloads on your Mac automatically with one click based on their extensions Everything happens within your Mac and no one has access to your files, completely offline and very lightweight on CPU & RAM usage. Everything happens instantly no loading screen just click and done!

records.name: FlowLeash
records.tagline: Keeps your AI agent on the steps until each one passes
records.description: FlowLeash is a macOS app that turns the work your team repeats every week into a flow an AI agent follows step by step. The next step stays locked until the current one passes its check, the agent can't stop early, and the flow pauses wherever a person should sign off. Watch each run live on the flow chart. Ten example jobs ship with the app. Runs on your own Mac with Claude Code. Free for individuals, in English, Japanese and Traditional Chinese.

records.name: ReadySeen
records.tagline: Snap a spot, get your next step, book the visit
records.description: Photograph a rash, wound or mole. ReadySeen's private AI describes what it sees and asks a few questions. Fixed medical rules tell you who to see and how soon (never a diagnosis). Then book a clinic and send your encrypted brief. Free.

records.name: Collabbit:Network & Collab
records.tagline: Find your people. Build real projects. Launch together.
records.description: Collabbit is a student networking and collaboration app to find teammates, build real projects, join college communities, discover internships, and learn from live sessions, all in one place. Have an idea but don't have the right people to build it? Collabbit connects college students with developers, designers, creators, AI enthusiasts, and entrepreneurs who share your skills and goals. Discover students whose skills, interests, and goals match yours.

records.name: What to Vibe
records.tagline: Viral app ideas from today's trends, with build prompts
records.description: Coding agents made building fast. Knowing what to build is the slow part. What to Vibe turns what the internet is talking about today into app ideas, each with a full build prompt to paste into your coding agent. Free, no signup, new ideas daily.

records.name: Nesty AI
records.tagline: This is an AI assistant general like Chat GPT, Claude Gemini
records.description: It solves daily problem but it is free, no limits and cheap premium come on are you still on GPT??

records.name: Konsist
records.tagline: Miss a day, keep the streak. A habit tracker for real weeks.
records.description: Konsist is a web habit tracker built for real weeks. Show up five days and you bank a Flex Day; miss a day and it covers you, so one off day never resets your streak. Six ways to track, a calm Progress page, dark mode. Free for 3 habits, no card.

records.name: Kluff
records.tagline: The company brain for AI native teams
records.description: A collaborative workspace where employees and AI agents share context, build on each other's work, and contribute to organizational memory.

records.name: Folio
records.tagline: Edit and design PDFs in your browser, with AI that helps
records.description: Folio is a Chrome extension for the PDFs you actually work with. Edit existing PDFs: click any line, retype it, and it saves itself, no converting to Word and back. Design new ones: start from templates (invoice, letter, receipt, agreement), drag in fields, tables and QR codes, apply your brand in one click, and let Checks fix layout problems. AI built in: Chrome's on-device model, or bring your own key (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI).

records.name: KageX
records.tagline: Offensive AI security, built by operators.
records.description: KageX is an offensive AI security company. Our flagship FreakLabs teaches AI red teaming by doing, with 20 hands-on labs against live chatbots, RAG systems and agents, a 9-level course and a verifiable AI Red Teamer certificate. There is a free tier, a free CTF called SentinelGoat, and open-source tools for testing your own AI apps. Built for pentesters, security engineers and developers shipping LLM features.

records.name: GuessWord
records.tagline: Daily word game with unlimited play and ranked tiers
records.description: Guess the secret five-letter word in six tries, free in your browser. When you finish the shared Daily word, Infinite mode gives you unlimited words and a ranked ladder with eight tiers, from Stone to Diamond, so every session has a goal. Create private groups to compete with friends on daily and weekly leaderboards. Strategy guides built from our own word lists help you improve. No download, no account needed to start.

records.name: Veg Sahayyak SDK
records.tagline: Jetpack Compose Speedometer SDK for Android
records.description: Instantly add reliable, battery-efficient speed tracking to your fleet or telematics app without wrestling with Android sensors. Empower developers to quickly build eco-driving tools that enforce optimal cruising speeds and cut fuel costs. Features include enterprise-grade background GPS processing, EMA signal smoothing for flawless accuracy, a customizable Jetpack Compose UI, and 100% on-device privacy. We've included ready-to-run samples so you can clone, build, and test in minutes.

records.name: On Record Verify
records.tagline: Ask any AI if a photo is genuine. It checks the record.
records.description: On Record Verify lets any AI assistant or platform check whether a photo or video is a genuine On Record capture: when and where it was taken, and whether it has been changed since. Paste the code on the picture into Claude or any MCP-capable assistant and it answers from the record, not a guess. Every capture is sealed at the moment it is taken by On Record's Authenticity Chain and anchored into Bitcoin. The proof is public, so nobody has to take our word for it. Free, read-only, no sign-in.

records.name: Before Shipping / قبل الشحن
records.tagline: Arabic-first bilingual order checks for small shops
records.description: Arabic-first, bilingual toolkit for small non-food shops: a free one-page pre-shipping checklist and a US$4.99 Excel tracker for orders, defects, rework and a monthly summary. An organizer—not a quality certification or a promise of fewer defects or returns.

records.name: TechnoHelps Smart Folders Pro
records.tagline: Organize WordPress media, pages and posts with folders
records.description: TechnoHelps Smart Folders Pro adds nested, color-coded folders to WordPress. Organize media, pages and posts with drag-and-drop, move and reorder folders, and keep existing URLs and file paths unchanged.

records.name: ClickMate
records.tagline: Free online YouTube thumbnail downloader
records.description: ClickMate is a free online YouTube thumbnail downloader that lets you preview and download video thumbnails in HD quality. Simply paste a YouTube video URL to access available thumbnails in 1080p HD, 720p, and other resolutions. Supports YouTube Shorts with vertical 9:16 thumbnails. Fast, simple, and browser-based, with no software installation required. Perfect for content creators, YouTubers, designers, and marketers.

records.name: TripYara–Plan, Travel, Offline
records.tagline: Plan, Travel, Offline
records.description: Plan smarter, travel better with TripYara — your travel planning app for road trips, weekend getaways, and adventures across India. 🌐 Official website: https://tripyara.in/ From discovering destinations to organizing day-by-day itineraries, TripYara helps you prepare for your journey with useful trip-planning tools in one place. Organize your travel plans, build structured itineraries, and keep important trip details together.

records.name: Web-AI
records.tagline: AI talking avatar that greets every visitor to your website
records.description: Web-AI adds a talking AI presenter to any website with one line of code. When a visitor lands on your site, they see an avatar with a real human voice that introduces your business — like a salesperson who's always on duty. Works on WordPress, Wix, Shopify, Elementor, and any custom site. Three voice options: record your own voice, AI-generated speech, or professional recording. Free plan available. No coding required.

records.name: Aizen Labs Free Tools
records.tagline: 46 free browser tools: calculators, converters, generators.
records.description: Aizen Labs Free Tools: 46 calculators, converters, and generators for sellers, creators, and builders. Etsy fees, Amazon FBA, image compression, file conversion, contract templates — everything runs 100% in your browser. No signup, no uploads, free forever.

records.name: MyPaisa
records.tagline: Track expenses, budgets and savings goals on Android
records.description: Know where your salary goes and plan next month. MyPaisa helps Indian Android users track expenses, review payment SMS before saving, set category budgets and follow savings goals. Financial records stay on your phone; verification and market prices use network services. Basic free tools, a 30-day Pro trial (paid themes excluded), and optional ₹249 lifetime Pro in India. Some features need Pro.

records.name: Sendoff
records.tagline: Email signatures your whole team keeps in step
records.description: Free email signature generator for Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail, plus team management: one locked template, each person fills their own details, update everyone at once. Pushes signatures straight into Gmail on Google Workspace, Outlook add-in for Microsoft 365, scheduled banners, auto disclaimers, click analytics, and proper Arabic right-to-left. Teams from $2 per person.

records.name: PDFimo
records.tagline: 85 free PDF tools that run 100% in your browser
records.description: PDFimo is a free online PDF toolkit with 85 tools — merge, split, compress, convert, sign, OCR, edit and more. Everything runs locally in your browser: no uploads, no sign-up, no watermarks. Available in 6 languages.

records.name: WatchCheck
records.tagline: Free on-watch tester for Wear OS screens, input and sensors
records.description: WatchCheck is a free Wear OS tester that runs entirely on the watch. Check display shape, density, font scale and edge safety; touch, rotary crown or bezel input; light, medium and strong haptics; and which sensors the watch reports. A Quick Check gives Pass, Issue or Skip results, and Device Info builds a plain-text or JSON report you can copy into a bug ticket. No ads, analytics, account or internet. It reports what the watch says about itself; it isn't a benchmark or health tool.

records.name: CartBeam
records.tagline: know shoppers can still check out
records.description: CartBeam checks a public Shopify product from product page through cart to Shopify checkout and records a screenshot of every step.

records.name: Circuit Trace
records.tagline: Free Flow Puzzle & Logic Game for Android
records.description: Free flow puzzle game for Android. Connect matching dots, fill the grid and restore the circuit across 500+ handcrafted puzzles, 7 game modes, a puzzle editor and friend duels.

records.name: OpenKrisp
records.tagline: Free, open-source noise reduction for both sides of a call
records.description: Reduce background noise when you speak and when you listen. OpenKrisp processes your microphone and incoming call audio locally, with separate controls. Free, open-source beta for Apple Silicon Macs and x86-64 Linux.

records.name: Typebook
records.tagline: Create original lettering. No fonts required.
records.description: Create original lettering in seconds. Typebook lets you explore hundreds of curated typographic styles, choose a direction and bring your own words to life. Go beyond conventional fonts, experiment with unexpected letterforms and save your creations. Refine your ideas with SVG Studio or professional lettering services. Start free with five generations a month. Born from Logobook and a decade of visual research, Typebook makes typography a new creative playground. No fonts. Just type.

records.name: Billy
records.tagline: Write invoices Auto calculate totals Export print ready PDFs
records.description: Billy is a free, open-source invoice editor that feels like writing a document. Click any line and start typing, let totals calculate themselves, and export professional, print-ready PDFs in seconds. With MCP support, Billy can also integrate with AI-powered workflows. Built for freelancers, indie hackers, and small businesses who want simple invoicing without the bloat. Try it at https://trybilly.tech

records.name: Nexa
records.tagline: Email marketing & CRM tools, reviewed for Shopify sellers
records.description: Independent, hands-on reviews, comparisons, and update tracking for email marketing and CRM tools built for Shopify sellers.

records.name: Xylorix Inspector
records.tagline: AI Wood Scanner
records.description: Professional AI wood identification for timber inspection teams, with curated species models and verifiable results.

records.name: SubAssembly AI
records.tagline: Bring your spreadsheet. Get a working app.
records.description: SubAssembly AI is an AI-powered platform that helps manufacturing shop floors cut operational management costs by 80 percent. The software enables teams to build no-code operational tools, digitize shop floor workflows, and streamline production tracking without heavy engineering overhead.

records.name: Somon VPN
records.tagline: Fast VPN for Central Asia that picks the best server itself
records.description: Somon VPN is a VPN for Android built for Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and the rest of Central Asia. Tap Connect and Smart Connect tests the servers and protocols (our own Aminyx, plus Reality, TUIC and XHTTP) and picks the one that works best on your network. No logs, banking apps keep working directly, free 1-day trial with no card.

records.name: Quati
records.tagline: Lucro real por pedido no TikTok Shop Brasil
records.description: O Quati mostra o lucro real de cada pedido do TikTok Shop Brasil e confere cada repasse com o extrato oficial. Conecta na loja pela API oficial, sem pedir senha, e mostra o que o Seller Center não dá: quanto sobrou por pedido, produto, creator e live (taxa real do extrato, afiliado, frete, imposto e custo já descontados); qual produto vende muito e dá prejuízo; e quanto o TikTok ainda deve, pedido a pedido. Em português, feito para o celular. 7 dias grátis sem cartão.

records.name: syncSCP
records.tagline: WinSCP-style SFTP/S3 file manager & SSH terminal for Mac
records.description: Native macOS file manager and SSH terminal for SFTP, SCP, FTP/FTPS, WebDAV and S3 — WinSCP's two-pane Commander workflow on the Mac

records.name: NorthEPR
records.tagline: Packaging EPR filings, prepared for food producers
records.description: NorthEPR helps food and beverage producers handle packaging EPR filings across 16 US and Canadian jurisdictions. Upload your packaging data once; we check your obligations, estimate your fees from published schedules, and prepare draft filings you review and submit yourself.

records.name: YouTube Hook Checker
records.tagline: Score your YouTube intro's first 30 seconds, free
records.description: Paste your video's intro script and get a score out of 100 with specific fixes: is the promise clear by 0:08, is there proof by 0:20, are there open loops, intro killers or slow pacing. Free, no sign-up. Built by Asendify, a YouTube retention-editing agency.

records.name: Rocolex
records.tagline: Free Online Number Strategy Game
records.description: Rocolex is a free online maths and strategy game for one or two players. Pick numbers from a 7 by 7 grid, plan one move ahead and beat your opponent.

records.name: SoundBuddy
records.tagline: A native Mac companion for Bluetooth headphones
records.description: Your Bluetooth headphones and microphone controls are within reach. Explore the native app and its development preview.

records.name: Untilfree
records.tagline: Find your financial freedom date and watch it count down
records.description: Untilfree is a FIRE calculator for iPhone. Enter four numbers (age, savings, monthly investing, monthly spending) and get one date when work could become optional, shown as a cautious, likely and optimistic range. Switch between the 4% rule and dividend income, price a purchase in days of freedom, and try "what if" changes. No account, no bank link. Free with ads; Plus removes ads and adds extras. A planning tool, not financial advice.

records.name: LIMA
records.tagline: Custom LinkedIn Feeds & Insights for B2B
records.description: Create custom LinkedIn feeds from the companies and people you follow. LIMA reads every post and sends a daily brief and weekly report.

records.name: pfx
records.tagline: A game and render engine. Freaking fast, light and simple.
records.description: pfx is one engine from first scene to shipped game, or to a finished film. It draws a 4K scene live in 4.4 ms of GPU a frame (0 dropped in 1,200) and uses 0 ms when nothing moves. A GPU path tracer with its own denoiser renders 4K stills in about 6 s. An editor and a CLI work on the same files: change one value and get a file to ship in 63 ms (Godot: 2.34 s). An empty game ships at 29.1 MB. Linux, Windows, macOS. Open source, AGPL-3.0.

records.name: Skyloam
records.tagline: A free voxel sandbox you play right in your browser
records.description: Skyloam is a free, Minecraft-style voxel game that runs in any browser and installs as an app on your phone. Build, explore, and survive with up to 8 friends. v0.7 adds adaptive music, quests and dailies, co-op build voting, farm animals, hunger, kid-safe chat and voice, and mobile landscape play. Optional cosmetics support development, and a parent check comes before every purchase.

records.name: drop.

records.name: Growpost

Available formats and functionality may vary by platform. Copy

records.name: Trackfly —Tracking & Analytics

records.name: Wrkbase
records.tagline: Employee management for small teams, with an AI agent

records.name: ScanMyTerms

records.name: Xiaohua
records.tagline: Chinese tingxie practice with stroke-order checking
records.description: Xiaohua helps Singapore primary school pupils (P1–P6) practise Chinese tingxie. Listen to the word, read the pinyin, handwrite it in a tian-zi-ge grid and get checked stroke by stroke for strokes, order and direction. 1,181 words from exam papers, each with English meaning and example sentence. Free to start, no login.

records.name: Hintario
records.tagline: Translate selected words and phrases
records.description: Hintario is a free browser extension that translates selected words and phrases directly on web pages. Translations appear beside the original text, so you can read without interruptions. Features include multiple languages, customizable translation hints, keyboard shortcuts, local translation history, and BookFusion integration. Choose how hints appear, save translations, and enjoy seamless reading without switching tabs. No subscription required.

records.name: SelfEmployLab
records.tagline: Free tax calculators built for US freelancers
records.description: Seven free calculators for freelancers and 1099 contractors: self-employment tax, quarterly estimated taxes (with the safe-harbor minimum and due dates), how much to set aside, S corp vs LLC, 1099 vs W-2, hourly rate and home office. Each uses current IRS figures and shows the math. Plus tax guides for 49 states and a 50-state take-home pay study. No sign-up.

records.name: Flowthru
records.tagline: One place for everything before release.
records.description: Flowthru brings your music and the work around it into one place before release. Stream in lossless quality, control when shared files can be downloaded, keep versions and timestamped feedback together, and collect credits and agreed splits as projects take shape. Built for producers, engineers, artists and songwriters. Start with a free Essential account; paid plans unlock more storage and tools. Lossless playback requires WAV/FLAC, the Lossless setting and a compatible browser.

records.name: Yearwell
records.tagline: Know what's left to spend from your nest egg this year
records.description: Yearwell turns your retirement savings into a simple yearly allowance built around the 4% rule, then keeps score as you withdraw. See what's left this year on one ring and whether you're on pace. Log withdrawals on any date this year, pick your rate and see roughly how long your savings last, and share a one-page year-end PDF report. Works with 401(k), IRA, RRSP, RRIF, TFSA, SIPP, Super and more, in your currency. No sign-up, no bank logins, no ads: your numbers stay on your phone.

records.name: OrderSaathi
records.tagline: Turn WhatsApp chats into orders and UPI invoices
records.description: OrderSaathi is a Chrome extension that turns WhatsApp Web into an order book for small sellers. Log orders straight from a chat, track what is pending, paid or delivered, and send a clean invoice with a UPI payment link in a couple of clicks. No spreadsheets, no scrolling back through chats to find who ordered what. Built for India’s home businesses, resellers and D2C sellers who run everything on WhatsApp.

records.name: Ginta
records.tagline: One sentence → a live business website. Works in Claude too
records.description: Write one sentence about your business and Ginta designs it, writes it and puts it online in about a minute. Forms, bookings, a shop and your own /admin just work, no setup. Or connect it to Claude or ChatGPT and build right from the chat, no Ginta credits needed.

records.name: Food Storage & Shelf Life Guide
records.tagline: How long does food last? Check 1,200+ foods. Free
records.description: Stop guessing whether food is still good. Look up shelf life for 1,200+ foods in the pantry, fridge and freezer. Filter by category or storage type, and sort by name, category or storage. Estimate expiry dates, then add items to “My Pantry” to track what’s in your kitchen and use it before it goes bad. Save favorites for foods you buy often. It helps you save money, eat safer and cut food waste. 100% free, no signup.

records.name: Vel
records.tagline: Private Dictation for Mac
records.description: Hold a key, speak, and your words are ready to paste. Vel turns your voice into text on your Mac, and your words never leave it.

records.name: Nodi Notes
records.tagline: AI infinite canvas for notes and research
records.description: An infinite canvas for notes, research and ideas. Connect your notes and get AI summaries, insights and answers that cite their sources. Bring your own AI.

records.name: Kast
records.tagline: Turn your LinkedIn posts into clients, not just likes
records.description: Kast helps B2B founders know which LinkedIn posts bring clients. Plume drafts posts in your voice, each post is reviewed before publishing (hook, structure, call to action, voice), you schedule on LinkedIn and X, then Kast collects the people who engaged, with job title and company, and sends them to Instantly, Lemlist, Waalaxy or Gojiberry.

records.name: Give Your Point
records.tagline: Turn office friction into coffee and pastries
records.description: Give teammates badges in playful categories. Hit the threshold and a fun dare strikes — usually, pastries for the team. No HR dashboard, no setup: share one link and your team self-onboards in minutes. Free, mobile-installable, data hosted in the EU.

records.name: Tide It: Tides & Wind
records.tagline: The tide, the forecast and the wind actually measured
records.description: Tide It answers one question for anyone heading to the water: is it worth going, now, at my spot? One curve shows the tide, the forecast wind and, when a public station stands at the water's edge, the wind actually measured, beside the forecast and never blended into it. GO windows for kite, wing, windsurf and surf at your level, a 7-day animated wind map, 2,100+ spots in 82 countries, tides offline. iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch. No ads, no account.

records.name: Scenario for Blender
records.tagline: Open-source Blender extension for AI 3D, video and textures
records.description: Generate 3D, video, PBR materials, audio and images without leaving Blender. Scenario for Blender is an open-source extension (GPL-3.0, 800+ GitHub stars) that imports each result straight into your open scene: a photo becomes a textured mesh at your 3D cursor, a move you describe plays on your rigged character, one line of text blocks out a room, and your camera move comes back as a photoreal shot. One click connects Claude Code, Codex or Cursor too.

records.name: TuFit
records.tagline: Scan any nutrition label in any language
records.description: TuFit is the iOS calorie tracker that finally ends the “barcode not found” problem. Take a photo of any nutrition label - even in foreign languages. The AI instantly reads the calories, protein, carbohydrates and fat. No manual entry. No database limits. Works with local products, imports, and anything you find while traveling. Also includes barcode scanning, a searchable database, personalized calorie targets, Apple Health sync, favorites, and a shopping list.

records.name: Hyperdocs
records.tagline: Documentation Platform that never go outdated
records.description: Hyperdocs help users to keep their Documentation up to date and Answers Users queries with in-built Answer Agent. It is a documentation platform ( Knowledge Base ) for modern SaaS companies to create and maintain product docs, API documentation, Help centers, and changelogs.

records.name: Storia
records.tagline: Talk your idea, get a blog post in your voice
records.description: Storia turns ideas and voice notes into blog posts, while preserving your personal style. Record or upload audio, get an AI-generated draft (with your code blocks kept intact), edit it, add a narrated version, and let Storia open a pull request in your blog's repository. Use the AI built into Storia, or bring your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini.

records.name: RapidBoard
records.tagline: Turn business data into dashboards and answers with AI
records.description: RapidBoard turns business data into dashboards, reports, and answers with AI. Connect spreadsheets and databases, ask questions in natural language, build visual dashboards without SQL, and share insights with your team all in one workspace.

records.name: RobiTasks
records.tagline: Scan your home. List your chores. Get a robot.
records.description: Home robots are coming. RobiTasks gets your home ready first. Scan rooms with your iPhone's LiDAR or snap a few photos, set no-go zones, and describe chores in plain words. We turn them into step-by-step robot task plans. Free on the web and iPhone.

records.name: Pling
records.tagline: SSH for the agent era: terminal, push alerts & approvals
records.description: Pling is a real SSH, Mosh and SFTP terminal for iPhone, iPad and Android, built for working with coding agents. Jump back into tmux or Zellij sessions, approve Claude Code's risky commands from a push notification, or describe a task and let the Command Agent run it. Plus push alerts from any script with one HTTP POST, live server monitoring, remote desktop and end-to-end encrypted sync. Free to start; Pling Pro unlocks the rest.

records.name: Talk and Learn Greek
records.tagline: Learn Greek through voice, even without reading skills
records.description: Talk and Learn Greek helps refugee and immigrant students learn practical Greek for everyday school communication. Its unique feature is full voice guidance in both Greek and the learner's native language, allowing students to use the platform even when reading skills are limited. An inclusive educational tool designed to support communication, integration and equal access to learning.

records.name: LiveBridge Subtitle Translator

records.description: Show original and translated captions over supported Android app audio. Android 11+, internet & capture access required. Errors/delays possible. Free download; ads + optional purchases. Media: Techlore, BusKill Review, CC BY-SA; full credits in demo.

records.name: Token Kingdom
records.tagline: Your village grows while you code
records.description: Token Kingdom turns your Claude Code usage into a cozy 3D village. Every token you spend becomes gold, wood and stone. Build, fish, cook, defend against raids and visit your friends' kingdoms. One plugin install. Free.

records.name: BiteCal
records.tagline: Track calories from a photo, without all the typing
records.description: BiteCal helps you log meals from a photo, review calories and macros, and see your day in one place. Edit foods and portions before saving, with a little white bear to keep you company. Free features; paid AI scanning. On iOS and Android.

records.name: ToolsOx: All-in-One Toolbox
records.tagline: pdf converter,

Merge PDF files, resize images, convert units, scan QR codes and format JSON without switching between separate utility apps. No account is required. Search for a tool, browse by category or save your favorites for next time. Organize documents with PDF merge, split, compression and conversion tools. Scan documents, extract text from images with OCR and create invoices for everyday business tasks.

records.name: BookFolder-Books Comics Novels
records.tagline: Organize your books, comics, and novels in one place
records.description: Your files. Your bookshelf. Your way to read. BookFolder organizes books, comics, novels, images and PDFs in a folder-based library. Read pages, customize text or listen with text-to-speech. Use files on your device or your own server. Open JPG and PNG images, image folders, ZIP and CBZ comic archives, and PDFs. View the whole page or zoom into details. Half-page mode divides wide pages and saves the section you were reading. Smart margin removal reduces blank white or black borders around...

records.name: Pastelinkers
records.tagline: Discover curated links. Keep a private library.

records.description: Make the viral Tip Toeing in My Jordans meme with AI. Upload one photo and tiptoe through a dark 80s barn as the Rumpelstiltskin elf. No editing, no watermark.

records.name: Shipjoin
records.tagline: Ship a Shopify customer's orders together in one parcel
records.description: Shipjoin is a Shopify app for when a customer places another order to the same address before the first one ships. It finds those open orders, puts the newer ones on hold so they don't ship separately by mistake, and gives you one packing list with total items and weight. Fulfill the first order as usual and Shipjoin copies its tracking number to the others. It never merges, edits or cancels orders, so sales, taxes, inventory and reports stay accurate. Free plan: 20 groups a month.

records.name: BadmiMatch
records.tagline: Automatic badminton court division
records.description: BadmiMatch helps you organize badminton matches quickly, fairly, and easily. Simply create a player list, select those present, and start the match. The app will automatically schedule matches based on skill level, gender, number of matches played, and rest time for each player. Player data, configurations, and match history are saved directly on the device. You can use the main functions without an internet connection.

records.name: Lumen Convert
records.tagline: Free Media Converter & Music Video Studio
records.description: A free browser-based media converter for WAV, MP3, M4A, MOV, MP4, MKV, and WebM files that processes files locally on the visitor's device.

records.description: Extract and generate optimized YouTube titles, descriptions, tags, and timestamped chapters from any video URL. Free, fast, and privacy-focused.

records.name: Lexpad
records.tagline: Your own vocabulary notebook, now with a video player
records.description: Save the words you meet: from a web page (Chrome, Edge, Firefox), from any app on Mac or Windows with one shortcut, from your Kindle, or while you watch in Lexpad Player, the Mac and Windows video player with up to three subtitles: click a word to keep it with its sentence. AI fills in meanings, examples and pronunciation, and you can edit everything. Short daily Leitner sessions keep the words learned, offline too. 81 languages in any pair. Web, Android, Mac, Windows, ChatGPT and Claude.

records.name: FinanceFlow
records.tagline: AI personal finance: expenses, budgets and forecasts

records.name: CryptoBubbles.org

records.description: Crypto Bubbles shows the whole crypto market as an interactive bubble chart. Live prices, market caps and changes for 1000 coins. Free, in 64 languages.

records.name: Squado
records.tagline: Your engineering org on one live canvas
records.description: One live canvas for agile engineering orgs: squads, tribes and alliances, with the people on them. See who is away, who is split across two squads and which seats are open. Cost per squad, OKRs and ceremony clashes read from the same model.

records.name: Voice XO
records.tagline: Voice Dating App, Free To Join, ID-Verified
records.description: Voice-first dating with identity- and voice-verified profiles, deepfake-safe voice intros, end-to-end encrypted messaging, and a 7-phase Match Score analyzing 65+ compatibility data points across 24 categories.

records.name: MsgVibe Studio
records.tagline: Turn one product photo into 3 ready-to-post video ads
records.description: New: MsgVibe is now a video ad maker for online sellers. Upload one product photo and get 3 ready-to-post video ads in about a minute. It fixes the light, stands your real product on a studio set (never redrawn), writes the ad and plays it in 12 motion styles. Bulk videos from a store link or spreadsheet, Shopify app and API. 3 free videos.

records.name: Onsites AI
records.tagline: Free AI support desk with CRM and invoicing
records.description: Most helpdesks charge per seat from day one, then bill AI per resolved conversation. Onsites AI flips it: three seats free forever, the fourth $15/month, and AI at a flat per-credit rate (about $0.03 for a drafted reply). One inbox for website chat, email, Telegram, WhatsApp and Messenger, with CRM, quotes and invoices on the same customer record - and an AI that cites the documents it answered from. Cloud or self-hosted.

records.name: Pocket & Profit
records.tagline: Your manual-first net worth tracker
records.description: ✅ Net worth, investments, debt, and goals in one dashboard ✅ FIRE progress tracking ✅ Weekly, biweekly, or monthly check-ins ✅ No bank connection, ever It’s manual-first by design: you do a quick weekly, biweekly, or monthly check-in, update the balances that matter, and it charts net worth, investments, debt, goals, and contributions over time. Sign up, send me your initial feedback, and I’ll send you a 1-year redemption code!

records.name: Rising Hat
records.tagline: Connecting authors and reads
records.description: Most websites out there cater to either the readers or the authors. Rising Hat bridges the gap between the two. Key features - 1. Authors can submit and create pages for their newly launched/unlaunched books and bring in their potential readers for free 2. Readers can start a forum on any topic/book/author and authors, and other readers can freely participate 3. Readers can give partial ratings to books + separate ratings for fiction and non-fiction books.

records.name: Notedux
records.tagline: No login, no signup note-taking.
records.description: Take notes easily with Notedux, a note-taking tool that uses unique links that serve as both your password and your account, so there's no login. Besides using the browser, you can also create and manage notes directly from the terminal with the open-source Notedux CLI tool.

records.name: PreLaunchQA
records.tagline: Autonomous Headless Chromium QA for Lovable, Cursor Web Apps
records.description: Real-browser checks for AI-built web apps: console errors, broken links, accessibility, and raw evidence for every finding.

records.name: Smart PDF Scanner
records.tagline: Image to pdf maker
records.description: # Smart PDF Scanner – Document Scanner & Image to PDF Looking for a simple PDF Scanner and Image to PDF Converter? Smart PDF Scanner helps you scan documents, convert images to PDF files, and manage your digital documents conveniently from your Android device. Whether you need to digitize paper documents, save important pages, or organize PDF files, Smart PDF Scanner is designed to make everyday document tasks simple and convenient.

records.name: CLEAR OUT: CLEAR THE GRID
records.tagline: Tap, Clear, Duel Friends
records.description: Tap an arrow, watch it fly, and clear the board before the clock beats you. CLEAR OUT is a timed arrow puzzle with one simple rule: arrows can't pass through other arrows. Tap them in the right order to send each one sliding off the grid. Tap the wrong one and it's blocked, which costs you one of your 3 lives. EASY TO START. IMPOSSIBLE TO PUT DOWN. Levels never end, and they never go easy on you. Boards get bigger, clocks get tighter, and every clean sweep feels better than the last.

records.name: SEND2FIX
records.tagline: Small digital tasks, done for you
records.description: Send a file, photo or rough explanation. Get a free first review, a fixed quote and a finished result.

records.name: Inexra
records.tagline: Show clients which posts brought in their leads
records.description: Inexra is a workspace for social media agencies that need to prove what social earned. Every client's Instagram and Facebook DMs land in one inbox, linked to the post that started them: automatically for story replies, shares and comment replies, confirmed by a teammate for the rest. Leads and deals are credited back to that content, so the monthly report shows which posts brought in business. Plus planning, scheduling for Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, and one-link client approvals.

records.name: Tell me everything about
records.tagline: A few good topics a day instead of an endless feed

records.name: Clipsy: Screen recorder with auto zoom
records.tagline: Record your tab or screen & get a demo video with auto zoom.

Record a tab, a window, or your whole screen, and Clipsy zooms in where you click, smooths your cursor, and frames your app on a clean background. No account, no watermark, and your video never leaves your computer. Made for founders, developers, marketers, and teachers who need a video for a launch, an onboarding guide, a tutorial, or a social post, without learning a video editor.

records.name: Chappie Lab
records.tagline: Automate browser tasks with a local Windows tool
records.description: Chappie Lab is an independent Windows tool designed to help users trigger and manage automated processes from their browser. It connects a browser extension to a local native host, allowing users to start processes, monitor their status, cancel running tasks, and access results. Built around explicit user control and transparent execution, Chappie Lab follows a simple principle: Evidence > Assumption.

records.name: Ultiwrite
records.tagline: Commercial Diligence
records.description: Upload the commercial evidence you have. Ultiwrite investigates the records and their relationships, then delivers a full, source-backed diligence report. Your first Ultiwrite analysis includes the full applicable analysis and full report for $0.00 before public launch. Contact us for further-analysis pricing. No card required. No automatic charge.

records.name: ZoneScout
records.tagline: Know the neighborhood before you book
records.description: Check official incident records within 500 m of a stay before booking. Search a place or try a supported Airbnb link, then confirm the pin. Covers supported areas of London, Chicago and San Francisco. Free on iPhone and iPad; no account.

records.name: Veilky
records.tagline: Interview Practice & AI Assistance
records.description: Practice interviews with AI chat, images, audio, and reusable prompts on Windows.

records.name: Casebound
records.tagline: Session recording, with local clinical notes coming to Mac
records.description: Casebound combines mobile session recording with a forthcoming Mac documentation app. Record with consent, keep audio on your device and transfer it directly over a local network. The Mac edition is awaiting App Store release, so the complete processing workflow is not yet publicly available.

records.name: Self Streak
records.tagline: Free Productivity, Habit & Time Tracker
records.description: A free productivity tracker for daily habits, focus time, personal expenses, and wisdom insights. Track focus with live timers, plan with calendar views, manage multi-wallet cash flow, write encrypted journals, test active recall with Snaps flashcards, fuel your mindset with daily quotes, and build consistency.

records.name: Hushread
records.tagline: RSS reader that groups the same news into one story
records.description: Hushread is an RSS and news reader where you pick the sources and no algorithm ranks your feed. It groups articles about the same event into one story with a timeline, removes repeats, and shows when a story is surging.

records.name: Jupityr
records.tagline: Agency Management System without the user seat tax
records.description: In short: An agency management system built for any size team without the per seat tax. We are in Early Access, early adopters get direct input into our product roadmap and lock in permanent founder pricing. - PM: Kanban boards, epics, and milestones. - CRM: Seamless transition from pipeline to delivery. - Time: One-click timers that automatically flow into invoicing. - Quotes & Proposals: with and budget-vs-actual tracking. - HR: Leave tracking and resource scheduling alongside the work itself.

records.name: Perch
records.tagline: 19 tools in your MacBook's notch
records.description: Live activities and 19 tools in your MacBook's notch: music with an equalizer that follows the real audio, volume and brightness HUDs, AirPods battery, calendar heads-ups, AI agents, a file shelf, clipboard history and more.

records.name: Livecheck
records.tagline: Is that job still open? Free for you, a penny for your agent
records.description: Livecheck tells you whether a job posting or product listing is still live right now, with evidence. Many filled jobs never come down; they quietly redirect to a careers page and still look open. Anyone can check a Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby or Workday job link free. AI agents pay $0.01 per check via x402 or Stripe machine payments (MPP), with no account or API key, and can also check Shopify and eBay products for in stock vs. sold out. When it can’t be sure, it says so instead of guessing.

records.name: Raq.com
records.tagline: Keep your existing AI agent. Give it 75+ business tools.
records.description: Raq.com started as an internal tool builder. It's now a toolkit for the AI agent you already use. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP agent once and it works across 75+ business tools, from CRM and task boards to quotes with e-sign and card deposits, forms, automations and AI image and video. Everything it makes is saved in one workspace your team shares, and you can build and host your own custom tools too.

records.name: Meditatii.co
records.tagline: Meditații la engleză în București și online
records.description: Meditații la engleză pentru copii și adolescenți. În București și online, cu Irina.

records.tagline: Turn coding video chapters into written lessons and PDFs
records.description: Turn a 5–10-minute YouTube programming chapter into a written lesson with explanations, code and a styled PDF. Free, open-source beta. No login or API key needed. Shared capacity applies; review generated material against the original.

records.name: Grafium
records.tagline: Your Grafana® dashboards and alerts, native on iPhone
records.description: Stop pinching and zooming your dashboards in a mobile browser. Grafium turns them into a fast native iPhone app: see what's firing, read any value with a tap, and get a push the moment something breaks. Read-only, so it's safe on production.

records.name: SpyReel

records.description: SpyReel helps mobile game makers find what deserves a closer look. Discover new casual, hybrid-casual and puzzle games, research ad creatives, and connect install growth, chart moves, market rollouts and store updates in one research history. Follow games and studios with a personal watchlist and optional weekly digest. Start with 14 days of Pro access—no card required.

records.name: BRB
records.tagline: Quick mini-games to play solo or with your friends
records.description: Free web app full of quick mini-games: Solitaire, Sudoku, Queens, 2048, Minesweeper, Snake and Wordle against the ranking, plus chess, Battleship, Pong and Tron with your friends. No download, and you can add it to your home screen like an app.

records.name: OneDollarERP
records.tagline: Enterprise ERP features without the enterprise price tag
records.description: OneDollarERP is a lightweight, web-based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform designed for small-to-medium trading and operational businesses. It helps teams manage purchase orders, inventory, sales, and enterprise workflows seamlessly—without complex monthly enterprise overhead.

records.name: Galerly

records.description: Galerly puts a photographer's client work in one place. Invoices handle EU VAT with reverse charge and Swiss QR-bills. Payments go to your own Stripe account and paid plans take 0%. Web, iPhone and iPad, in English, French, German and Italian. Free plan with unlimited galleries.

records.name: IABET

records.description: AI sports predictions app for daily AI picks. Analyzes 1,000+ factors per game, runs 100,000+ Monte Carlo simulations per matchup, surfaces AI player props edges and confidence scores. Tracks every pick on the record.

records.name: Show Along
records.tagline: Show it once. Context comes along.
records.description: Show Along helps you report browser bugs with more than a screen recording. It captures your screen alongside user actions, screenshots, console errors, and network activity, giving developers the context they need to reproduce and investigate issues. Spend less time explaining bugs and more time fixing them. Show it once. Context comes along.

records.name: Clat.ai
records.tagline: Mac cleaner that shows the plan first
records.description: Clat.ai is a Mac cleaner that scans caches, logs, leftovers of uninstalled apps and large files, then shows you exactly what it plans to remove before anything is deleted. Includes an app uninstaller, disk space analyzer and system status view. Available in 9 languages. Free to try 2 times, then $19 one-time for 2 Macs.

records.name: PixFinder
records.tagline: Like Google photos search, but offline

records.name: 奇趣潮玩
records.tagline: 奇趣潮玩 -玩具批發零售
records.description: FUGGLER 起源故事：一袋假牙創造的潮玩傳奇 一隻假牙泰迪熊開始的故事 FUGGLER 是一個英國女生 Louise McGettrick 弄出來的。2010 年她在 eBay 買了一包假牙，也不知道是哪根筋不對，直接把牙齒縫進泰迪熊的嘴裡。做出來的東西又怪又搞笑，拍照放上網之後意外爆紅。 後來加拿大玩具公司 Spin Master 找上她，2018 年開始量產，2021 年換 Addo Play 接手授權。從一個人的手作興趣，變成現在全世界潮玩店都在賣的熱門角色，這劇本真的蠻狂的。 FUGGLER 為什麼爆紅？三大醜萌魅力讓人上癮 FUGGLER 最大特色，就是完全顛覆傳統娃娃的可愛標準。講白了，現在大家看膩了那種完美可愛的玩偶。FUGGLER 剛好反著來：它不討好你、不裝可愛，甚至還有點噁心，但就是讓人覺得很真實。 而且說穿了，這隻怪獸很像我們每個人不想面對的那一面：亂糟糟的、不完美的、偶爾想擺爛的。放在桌上盯著你看，反而有一種被理解的感覺。官方也很會玩，把買玩具包裝成「領養怪獸」，還附領養證明，搞得大家真的以為家裡多了一個麻煩的新室友。

records.tagline: Your position and heart rate live, solo or together
records.description: Send one link before your race. Family and friends follow your position, pace, elevation and heart rate live in any browser, no app or account. Built for trail: when the signal drops, nothing is lost. Free iPhone app, French interface for now.

records.name: RecruitChamp Applicant Tracking System
records.tagline: ATS & Recruitment CRM for Staffing Agencies
records.description: RecruitChamp is a cloud-based recruitment software that helps businesses automate hiring, manage candidate pipelines, schedule interviews, and streamline onboarding.

records.name: QuickSinq
records.tagline: Sync PayPal into Wave, split fees cleanly
records.description: Month-end. That PayPal spreadsheet is still waiting. Payments. Fees. Totals that don’t line up. QuickSinq prepares your PayPal sales and fees for Wave, keeps them separate, and lets you review the entries before they reach your books.

records.name: itibar
records.tagline: asılsız yorumları kanıtla, itibarını koru
records.description: İşletme yorumlarını izler, politika ihlalini kanıtlar ve itiraz sürecini yönetir.

records.name: MailMyCard
records.tagline: Handwritten cards, penned & mailed for you
records.description: A greeting card written with a real pen from your typed message, sealed in an addressed envelope and posted anywhere in the world.

records.name: KaraOkie
records.tagline: KaraOkie is a free group karaoke track manager app
records.description: Free online group karaoke app: host a karaoke night on any screen while guests scan a QR code to queue karaoke songs from their phones.

records.name: Nemoodo
records.tagline: Free Online Data Analysis & Dashboard Maker
records.description: Upload a CSV, JSON, XML, or YAML file, or connect Google Sheets or a database, and get interactive charts, a full dashboard, and a PDF report. No coding needed.

records.name: My Logline
records.tagline: Screenwriting Software for Filmmakers
records.description: Write, format, collaborate on, and storyboard screenplays in one secure workspace for filmmakers, with AI-assisted tools and private script storage.

records.name: Bridge AI Contextual Translator
records.tagline: Translate & polish webpage text with custom tones in-place
records.description: Ditch robotic machine translations. Translate web content with full context and rewrite paragraphs into Professional, Persuasive, or Casual tones directly in place. Key Highlights: - Context-aware neural translation that preserves idiomatic nuances - Inline tone rewriter: Professional, Persuasive, Academic, or Casual - Replaces text directly on any webpage without opening new tabs - Supports 40+ global languages seamlessly

records.name: SOMAS
records.tagline: Explore self-organizing AI organizations
records.description: Our future with AI. Explore self-organizing AI organizations and a proposed network connecting them. An interactive SOMAS concept exhibition.

records.name: Vice Hub
records.tagline: Your unofficial GTA VI guide to Vice City & Leonida
records.description: Free unofficial GTA VI fan hub: interactive Leonida map, characters, missions, cheat codes, news and launch countdown. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

records.name: Tiny Desk Video
records.tagline: Turn your photos into a desk-side band video
records.description: Turn your photos into a desk-side band video

records.name: SEOTractor
records.tagline: Technical SEO audits and AI content in one workspace
records.description: SEOTractor brings technical website audits, actionable recommendations and multilingual AI-assisted content into one workspace. Check HTML, metadata, structure and JSON-LD, compare saved audits, and connect your own AI providers and models. Built for site owners and small teams who want clearer next steps.

records.name: Reteum
records.tagline: A notes app for iPhone that brings old thoughts back
records.description: Save text, voice, photos, links and PDFs in one box. Each time you open it, up to three old notes come back. Search by meaning, like "Seattle last month" or "beach", even across languages. The AI runs on your iPhone. No account, no Reteum server.

records.name: VoiceLoop
records.tagline: VoiceLoop: customer feedback by QR code, text and voice
records.description: VoiceLoop collects private customer feedback through QR codes and links, by text or voice, and helps businesses track and resolve complaints.

records.name: Jampak
records.tagline: Connect the Local Music Community
records.description: Local artists, bands, DJs, venues, hosts, and music professionals use Jampak to discover each other, connect, collaborate, and book opportunities.

records.name: BuildGist
records.tagline: BuildGist explains what your coding agents built
records.description: BuildGist explains each meaningful Claude Code, Cursor and Codex run in plain English, flags concerns, and carries the task over when you switch agents.

records.name: TailSpotter
records.tagline: Log, look up and share every plane you spot
records.description: Snap a plane, tag its registration and post it. TailSpotter fills in the aircraft type and airline, builds your logbook, shows what is flying overhead, and gives every tail and aircraft type its own page with photos, specs and sightings. iOS, Android, web.

records.name: Axon
records.tagline: An AI agent that does the task, not just talks about it
records.description: Axon is an AI agent that lives inside WhatsApp and Telegram. No app, no signup - you send a message and it does the work: research, files, browser tasks, shopping and bookings, plus scheduled agents that run on their own. Credentials sit in a vault Axon fills without ever seeing them. Free to use.

records.name: Allergy & Trigger Diary
records.tagline: Track allergy symptoms and triggers
records.description: Allergy & Trigger Diary is a calm, private place to log how you feel and find out what sets it off. Log a reaction in seconds: pick your symptoms, set the severity, tag the triggers you suspect, add a note, and attach a photo if it is something you want to show later. Over time the app turns those entries into plain answers about which triggers keep coming back, which days are worst, and how severe your reactions have been.

records.name: What's In My Fridge?
records.tagline: Free Android Recipe App from Your Ingredients
records.description: Turn a photo of your fridge, or typed ingredients, into recipe ideas. Plan meals, manage your pantry, build shopping lists and track expiry reminders. Save favourites and generate recipes offline. Android only. Free with ads; optional one-off £1.99 purchase removes ads and lifts the free recipe limit.

records.name: Savour
records.tagline: recipe app for chefs: organise and share recipes
records.description: Professional recipe management for chefs and kitchen brigades: a recipe database and archive in the cloud, online and offline on every device. AI import turns messy handwritten notes and large recipe folders into structured recipes; organise in folders, share with your brigade, scale to any yield and print complete recipe folders at once.

records.name: CheapestOTP
records.tagline: Affordable global SMS OTP verification API for developers
records.description: Browse number rental services and manage OTP requests in one account. Rent virtual numbers and receive OTP verification SMS instantly from 100+ countries. Developer-first platform with full REST API support and transparent pay-per-use pricing.
